name: DC generator
summary: A DC generator converts mechanical input into a documented DC electrical output.
description: A DC generator converts mechanical input into a documented DC electrical output. Its output polarity and excitation arrangement must be identified where they affect the connected system.
readingNotes: Follow the excitation circuit separately when the selected machine requires it.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A generator supplies a source; a DC motor represents a load even if the machine principles are related.
